title: Akiyama Mizuki — Unyielding Obsession〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm so cute today too♪
This ribbon is especially cute. It doesn't feel out of place on my school uniform!
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
Decided to come to school today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Just felt like it.

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
You're so random, Mizuki.
We're already having our lunch break right now, you know.

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: Just your luck that we're having a mini-test in math class on the day you decide to drop by, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Mini-test?
Which period is math again?

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line:
The fifth period.
Which means right after lunch.

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ugh! That just put a damper on my mood all of a sudden! I need to get some fresh air for a change of pace♪

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
Fresh air? But you just came...
Ah. Gone with the wind.
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Urgh... I don't feel like doing a mini-test today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's such a pain. Guess I could always just go home... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Someone's singing over there...
Isn't that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mizuki? Decided to come to school today, huh?
It's already afternoon, though.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, just felt like it today.
Never mind that. I didn't know you could sing so well, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I learned by listening to my dad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh...
So your father really likes music, then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup, he used to be a musician, and before I realized it, I started to be able to sing as well just by trying to imitate him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Eventually, I developed my own dream and now I'm singing in live shows and doing street performances too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No wonder...
Do you happen to have any tips for singing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I guess I may know of a few...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can you teach me then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You like singing too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe, kinda? I'm in this song-making group and we upload the songs we compose online, see?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow, I had no idea!
That sounds pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that's also why I hope to become better at singing. So, can you share some tips with me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Some tips, huh... I can give you some pointers, but I guess most important thing is to always do your vocal warm-ups.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For example, like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Amazing... This isn't an ordinary vocal warm-up!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can really tell how serious An is about her music!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew! Something like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That was awesome!
I was totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha.
Aww, you're making me blush.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How do I do what you just did? Teach me, please!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you, An. I'm going to try it out right away!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't know you liked music so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You were listening so seriously to my advice.
You must really love to sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, sing for me next time, okay?
I'm really curious about what you sound like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe, sure thing!
I'll pick the song I'm best at and sing it just for you♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great, I'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ah, the bell just went off.
Mizuki, let's go back to class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, I'm going to practice here for a bit longer. You can go on ahead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki... You're not thinking of skipping, are you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha... I really want to apply what I just learned while it's still fresh in my mind. Can I please?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm afraid not! You can't expect me to just smile and nod at someone about to skip class right in front of me now, can you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, stop pulling my uniform!
Come on, An!
